info.name: casertano.name API
info.description:
Public API for Dario Casertano's portfolio — Express.js/TypeScript

- **Development:** http://localhost:3001
- **Production:** https://casertano.name

## Authentication
None — fully public API.

## Response format
All JSON responses (except bare status codes) follow:
```json
{
  "code": <HTTP_STATUS>,
  "text": "<STATUS_DESCRIPTION>",
  "pyld": <BODY>
}
```

request.description:
Sends a contact message via email.

**Rate limit:** 5 requests per 15 minutes

**Required fields:**
- `cf-turnstile-response` — Cloudflare Turnstile token
- `consent` — must be `"on"` (privacy consent)
- `email` — valid email address
- `message` — message body (max 255 chars)
- `name` — sender name (min 3 chars)
